findings.issue: IEEE_CLASS invoked without its own IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE guard (17.11.2 p4)
findings.resolution: every plan invoking a restricted IEEE procedure, including as an observer, carries that procedure's guard

findings.issue: 17.9 conformance plans under-covered the named operations and weakened subnormal SQRT to finite and positive
findings.resolution: infinity and subnormal cases for +, -, *, /, IEEE_REM, IEEE_RINT and SQRT, each exact under guards

findings.issue: modes/status round trips required every support at once and observed only an exception flag
findings.resolution: one guarded branch per mode component; IEEE_SET_STATUS restores a flag and a mode together

findings.issue: signed-zero plans relied on a bare -0.0 literal
findings.resolution: negative zero built with IEEE_COPY_SIGN, pre-verified with IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE

findings.issue: reopened: the subnormal SQRT input 2^-127 is an odd power of two, and the stated expected value squared to 2^-126
findings.resolution: an even exponent e = (m-2) - MODULO(m-2,2) with m = MINEXPONENT-1, guarded to stay subnormal: SQRT(2^e) == 2^(e/2) (2^-128 -> 2^-64; 2^-1024 -> 2^-512)
